chapters.title: Number Systems
chapters.description: Real numbers, representation of irrational numbers on number line, real numbers and their decimal expansions, operations on real numbers, and laws of exponents for real numbers.

levels.title: Real Numbers & Decimal Expansions
levels.description: Terminating and non-terminating recurring decimal expansions, converting non-terminating recurring decimals into rational p/q form.
subtopics: Locating sqrt(2) on number line using spiral

levels.title: Operations on Real Numbers & Rationalisation
levels.description: Adding, multiplying, and rationalising expressions with square roots.
subtopics: Laws of real exponents a^p * a^q

levels.title: Chapter 1 Review & NCERT Exemplar
levels.description: Mixed problem solving on number systems.

chapters.title: Polynomials
chapters.description: Definition of a polynomial in one variable, coefficients, terms, degree of polynomial, zero polynomial, Remainder and Factor theorems, and algebraic identities.

levels.title: Polynomials & Zeroes
levels.description: Degrees of polynomials (linear, quadratic, cubic), and finding zeroes of p(x).
subtopics: Zeroes of linear and quadratic polynomials

levels.title: Factor Theorem & Splitting Middle Term
levels.description: Factor Theorem statement and proof; factorising quadratic trinomials ax^2 + bx + c and cubic polynomials.
subtopics: Factoring cubics using rational roots test

levels.title: Algebraic Identities & Factorisation
levels.description: Expanding and factoring using (x+y+z)^2, (x±y)^3, and x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz.

levels.title: Chapter 2 Review & Polynomial Mastery
levels.description: Review of algebraic identities and polynomial factoring.

chapters.title: Coordinate Geometry
chapters.description: The Cartesian plane, coordinates of a point, names and terms associated with coordinate plane, plotting points in the plane.

levels.title: The Cartesian Plane & Coordinates
levels.description: Abscissa, ordinate, origin, four quadrants, and plotting coordinates.
subtopics: Signs of coordinates in each quadrant

levels.title: Chapter 3 Review & Graph Plotting
levels.description: Graph interpretation and geometric shapes on the Cartesian plane.
